_comment: MiniMax-H3-Image LoRA/LoKr training (text-to-image). The adapter (models/minimax_h3_image) loads MiniMax's ORIGINAL checkpoint layout directly and converts it in memory: transformer/ + pdd_fused_heads.safetensors + vae/, with the Qwen3-VL text encoder read from text_encoder/. No diffusers model classes are involved -- the DiT and the VAE are vendored inside UTrainer. The model is a guidance-distilled, 6-step PDD checkpoint: one output head per sampling step, and training picks the head whose sigma band contains the sampled sigma.
_loss_note: guide_flow_matching (DC-Gen Eq. 10) is the correct objective here: MiniMax-H3-Image is a CFG-DISTILLED checkpoint, so its output already IS the CFG-combined velocity and plain flow_matching is biased. The loss needs the cached empty-prompt embedding (written at cache-build time from encode_text('')) and runs a second forward per step -- on a PDD model BOTH forwards carry the same sigma, therefore the same output head, which is what makes the correction valid. fixed_guidance_scale must be the checkpoint's effective distillation scale w*: 1.5 is only a placeholder -- measure it with `python -m UnifiedTrainer.utils.estimate_guidance_scale --config <this config>` before a long run, and prefer the measured value (md/09 shows a wrong, spread-out w is worse than plain FM). freq_sigma_max is 0.3, NOT the qwen21 habit of 0.05: this model's PDD grid only has sigma values 1.0 / 0.9675 / 0.8875 / 0.75 / 0.5328 / 0.232, so 0.3 makes the FFT term fire on exactly the last step (sigma 0.232) and nowhere else. Plain flow_matching remains available as an A/B arm.

training._training_note: timestep_sampling 'pdd' samples sigma from the checkpoint's distilled steps (1.0, 0.9675, 0.8875, 0.75, 0.5328, 0.232) -- the heads were trained on exactly those levels; 'uniform' draws uniform sigma in between. quantize: 'prequantized' loads the nf4 snapshot (16 GB), 'fp8' streams/loads an fp8 snapshot (33 GB, 1024² only), 'nf4' quantizes from the bf16 shards. lokr_model_type 'minimax_h3_image' selects the block + token-refiner pattern preset and the checkpoint-layout LoKR export (one file, resumable + ComfyUI).

validation._validation_note: val_loss stays PLAIN flow_matching MSE on the raw weights (validation.loss_types / use_ema), so the number tracks the saved checkpoint and is comparable across runs. Image sampling is the checkpoint's own 6-step PDD grid (adapter-owned loop): one output head per step, data-ward Euler in float32, guidance 1.0.
